content.short: Drops checks and tracks wallet addresses for unclaimed airdrops and provides Telegram alerts on eligibility.
content.description: Drops is an airdrop checker, tracker and Telegram bot that automatically identifies unclaimed crypto airdrops for users. You can scan any wallet address across multiple networks, including Aptos, Bitcoin, Solana, Starknet, ZKSync, Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Avalanche and OP Mainnet, to discover eligible drops, and you'll receive Telegram alerts when you qualify, helping you stay informed and act quickly. Drops remains fully anonymous and secure, and there's no need to connect a wallet.
